recap.text: Dong arrives via a teleport trap with Katia, Imani, Splash Zone, and Bigs the slugalette. He carries a lance and Mr. Jefferson, a tube sock of nickels, while riding a swamp yak named Gonk. Dong and Carl enter the Madness castle and leave two conscripted crawlers bound. In a surgical theatre, Carl interrupts Architect Houston. Mr. Jefferson ends a mercenary, who bursts into coins. Dong catches one spinning coin and drops it into the sock.

Dong Quixote falls before the garage of the Lady Dominators and suffers Negative ROI. He holds two halves of Corcunda together for a fleshmancer in the back of a truck. Wearing a scarf, Dong mounts Corcunda and charges Grull with a lance affected by Big-Ass Magnet. Grull grants them a good death.

beats.headline: A mercenary with a lance and a sock
beats.text: I come through a teleport trap meant for Holger, who would not leave the children, and present myself outside the Madness castle alongside Katia, Imani and Splash Zone, with Bigs the slugalette riding behind me, and I bring with me the lance, which I have carried without a mount since the club came down, and Mr. Jefferson, who is a tube sock of nickels and a better conversationalist than most of this company. And beneath me is a swamp yak that once bore King Rust. Gonk. I am mounted again.
beats.gist: Dong Quixote arrives at Madness castle riding Gonk the swamp yak with a lance and nickel sock.

beats.headline: Into the Madness castle
beats.text: Carl and I go deeper into the castle while the great ball of crawlers rolls toward it, and on the way we take two crawlers who did not choose to fight us, conscripted, and leave them bound and unharmed behind us. In the surgical theatre at the back is Architect Houston, midway through joining himself to a changeling's body, with a crawler strapped to the table beside him. I hold the doorway. Carl interrupts the procedure.
beats.gist: Carl and I enter the Madness castle and leave two conscripted crawlers bound behind them.

beats.headline: A gold coin for Mr. Jefferson
beats.text: The last mercenary meets Mr. Jefferson and flies into the wall, and bursts into a scatter of coins, which is something that happens when a man is ended by a sock. Gonk is chewing a guard she has on her horns. I dismount and look over the coins. One is still spinning. I catch it up, kiss it, open the sock and drop it in. Carl says he thought they were all nickels in there. I am muttering to myself, and I do not answer him.
beats.gist: Dong Quixote meets Mr. Jefferson, flies into a wall, and bursts into coins.

beats.headline: Down outside a garage door
beats.text: I go to the garage of the Lady Dominators because Corcunda is inside it, and I fall down before I reach the door. They carry me back to our own garage, where I had left Mr. Jefferson, and Imani is sent for. Whatever she tells Carl, she tells him in silence, and nobody tells me. The quest to bring Corcunda's halves together advances a stage regardless. I did not earn that stage.
beats.gist: Dong Quixote falls before the Lady Dominators garage door while seeking Corcunda.

beats.headline: His greatest shame
beats.text: There is a way to bring him home. A spell split Corcunda in two, long ago, and his other half never cared for me; join the two with a fleshmancer and he is freed from those women and their team. And I must confess why he left. I did not want him to go back to his other half. I was afraid that once the two were whole again, the whole would not like me either. When he went, he asked me to go with him. I did not. It is my greatest shame.
beats.gist: A fleshmancer can join Dong Quixote with his other half to free him from the women.

beats.headline: I shall drive
beats.text: I ran down to the wreck to speak with Corky, and those women gathered him up and carried him into their garage and pushed me aside without a word. So be it. Carl and the princess both laid hands on the controls in that race, and so neither of them may touch them in the next. I shall drive. He says we will talk about it. What is there to discuss?
beats.gist: Dong Quixote says he shall drive because Carl and the princess touched the controls.

beats.headline: Nickels, not gold
beats.text: A brawl in the Lollipop, and a crawler singing through it, and so I take up Mr. Jefferson and sweep the stage clear before him, howling as I go. A mantis creature tears the good sock open as I strike her, and out come the coins, and half the room falls upon them. They are nickels. Every one of them is a nickel, though I have been feeding him honest gold pieces. I do not understand it.
beats.gist: Dong Quixote sweeps the stage clear for Mr. Jefferson and strikes a mantis creature.

beats.headline: The other side of the door
beats.text: This is unbearable, Carl. I am on the other side of the door, and I cannot even see him. He is the love of my life, and what you mean to do will change him forever, and I am not to be allowed to say goodbye. I am dying besides. They call the thing upon me Negative ROI, and Mr. Jefferson has stopped speaking to me, and my health is seeping away. I do not complain of the curse, my good sir. I complain of the door.

beats.headline: Why he fell in love
beats.text: Do you know why I fell in love with him, my boy? I will tell you. There was a battle in the Desperado Club not long after he was split, and I was afraid it would spread to the Penis Parade and we would all perish. Corky put his hand upon my shoulder and said that if we died that day, we would die together, and that is more than most people get. There is no such thing as a sad ending by the side of the people who make you happy. And now his other half stands before me, wearing my scarf.
beats.gist: Dong Quixote says he fell in love with Corky after Corky offered to die together.

beats.headline: Holding the halves together
beats.text: They get Corky away from the Dominators and bring both halves of him and a fleshmancer into the back of the truck, mid-race, and my part in the work is to hold the two of them together with everything I have while it is done. I am not well. I hold him anyway. Their two lives become one under my arms, and there is one Corcunda where there had been two.
beats.gist: Dong Quixote holds two halves of Corky and a fleshmancer together in a truck mid-race.

beats.headline: A charge, and a good death
beats.text: Grull, god of war, came for Corcunda on the racetrack, and Corcunda took the smite to spare the rest of them. Dong Quixote wore the scarf his partner had put about his neck, mounted him, and drew the war lance out of inventory. Princess Donut cast Big-Ass Magnet on that lance and every loose screw in the factory came to it. The pair of them went into Grull at speed, and the lance landed. Grull called it a good death and granted them one. Mercenary, formerly of the Penis Parade. Vale to you all, he said. Vale.
beats.gist: Dong Quixote, a mercenary formerly of the Penis Parade, kills Grull with a magnet-attracted war lance.
